question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The sermon of the priest was very short and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "concise."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word** "concise"** means giving a lot of information in a few words; brief. (थोड़े शब्‍दों में काफ़ी सूचना देते हुए; संक्षिप्‍त)

 
 
• Example: *He gave a clear and **concise**__ summary of what had happened.*
 
 
 
• The word **"concise"** is fitting in the blank because it means presenting information in a clear and succinct manner without unnecessary details or elaboration.
 
• Describing the sermon as** "short and concise"** suggests that the priest delivered the message effectively, conveying the essential points without unnecessary length or verbosity.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence: *The sermon of the priest was very short and __**concise**__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Coned: **conical in shape. (आकार में शंक्वाकार)
 
• **Conveyance: **the process or system of transporting or taking somebody/something from one place to another. ((व्यक्ति या वस्तु) एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर ले जाने की क्रिया; परिवहन)
 
• **Consisted: **be composed or made up of. (बना हुआ या बना हुआ होना)
